name: Business logic flaw
signals: client controls a value the server should enforce
workflow step can be skipped or repeated
role or sequence changes the outcome
safe_tests: use self-owned test accounts and synthetic products
change one business value or state transition
avoid real money, real users, and irreversible actions
confirm: a real business invariant is violated
benefit or unauthorized state is reproducible with test data
impact is quantified without causing business harm
